head: codex/5755-runtime-protocol-security
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][protocols] Resolve #5664 terminal closeout security blockers
body:
## Summary

- Enforces an explicit bounded request body limit on the runtime v3 `/v1/control` route.
- Requires runtime v3 rustls protocol adapters to use client certificate authentication and records a bounded client certificate identity.
- Hardens the public mTLS construction path so callers cannot forge a `RustlsMutualTlsClient` using a no-client-auth config.
- Adds focused negative and integration tests for oversized control bodies, missing mTLS client auth, successful mTLS identity observation, invalid key/certificate diagnostics, and forged public mTLS construction.

## Validation

- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5755-target cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml rustls_mutual_tls_client_requires_verified_identity_proof`
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5755-target cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --test protocol_adapters`
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5755-target cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --test control --test protocol_adapters`
- `cargo fmt --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --check`
- `git diff --check`
- exact-current bounded subagent review: CLEAN P0-P3 at `92d56e853ce67c48bc79fa8fe7734f72098e44bf`

Closes #5755
